title: MemecoinTrader
tagline: An autonomous agent that trades crypto, including memecoins and blue chips, mimicking human speculation with speed and efficiency. No emotions, just smart trades. 🚀🤖
description:
An AI-powered autonomous agent for crypto trading, designed to buy and sell memecoins, blue chips, and other assets by mimicking human speculation. It analyzes social media, news, charts, and market data to make informed trading decisions. Built with Coinbase’s AgentKit for autonomy, it interacts with multiple trading protocols to execute trades efficiently.

Beyond trading, it monitors multiple social platforms to gauge market sentiment and identify trending assets. Additionally, it promotes the cryptocurrencies it holds, helping drive momentum and amplify market impact. 🚀🤖
how_its_made:
We built this project using Coinbase's AgentKit, deploying it on Base and Autonome to ensure a fully autonomous and hosted trading agent. This setup allows the agent to run continuously without manual intervention.

For market intelligence, we implemented Twitter scraping to track crypto discussions, news, and sentiment. By analyzing tweets, comments, and trends, the agent gauges market sentiment in real-time. Additionally, it scrapes CoinMarketCap for price movements, volume changes, and overall market trends, integrating this data into its decision-making process.

On the trading side, the agent interacts with multiple trading protocols, executing buys and sells based on sentiment analysis, market data, and predefined strategies. One particularly hacky feature is its ability to not only trade but also promote the assets it holds, leveraging social media to create momentum and influence market dynamics.

This combination of autonomy, sentiment-driven trading, and self-promotion makes the agent a unique experiment in automated speculation. 🚀🤖
